entities.summary: The Mithra Temple of Maragheh, also referred to as Mithra Temple of Verjuy or simply Mehr Temple, is a mysterious underground place of worship of the Indo-Iranian god Mitra, dating back thousands of years, near the northwestern Iranian city of Maragheh. It is located 6 km south of Maragheh city in the village of Varjavi, East Azerbaijan province, and is one of the oldest surviving Mithraic temples in Iran.
